### Group E: Stellaer Rank 9 Alternative Xyz & Material Boost Archetype (10 Cards)
**Auditor**: Yu-Gi-Oh! Card Effect & Lua Script Engine Auditor

A thorough audit of the 10 custom "Stellaer" monster scripts in [`public/CCG Downloads/CCG_Scripts/`](file:///c:/Manual%20Files/Applications/YugiohCCG.github.io/public/CCG%20Downloads/CCG_Scripts/) was conducted against their authoritative printed card texts.

### Group G: Stain Archetype & Face-Up Opponent Deck Manipulation (13 Cards)
**Auditor:** Card Effect & Lua Script Auditor (ocgcore / YGO Omega)

An exhaustive audit of the 13 custom cards comprising the "Stain" archetype in `public/CCG Downloads/CCG_Scripts/` was conducted against their printed texts in `public/CCG Downloads/CCG_Database/CCG_v1.db`.

1. **Critical Engine Desynchronization with Deck State**: The "Stain" archetype introduces the mechanic of shuffling cards face-up into the opponent's Deck and interacting with face-up cards in the Deck. While `GLOBALFLAG_DECK_REVERSE_CHECK` is correctly enabled, several scripts suffered from improper filter conditions (e.g., `Card.IsFaceupEx` returning `false` for cards in the Deck, breaking deck search entirely on [c259475154.lua](file:///c:/Manual%20Files/Applications/YugiohCCG.github.io/public/CCG%20Downloads/CCG_Scripts/c259475154.lua#L80)).

2. **Missing Pre-Condition & Activation Checks**: In effects featuring simultaneous "A, and if you do, B" conjunctions (e.g. Dante, Rollo, Feness), the scripts failed to verify `e:GetHandler():IsAbleToDeck()` in `chk==0`, permitting illegal activations when the card cannot return to the Deck.

3. **Severe Runtime Crash Risks**: In [c247789143.lua](file:///c:/Manual%20Files/Applications/YugiohCCG.github.io/public/CCG%20Downloads/CCG_Scripts/c247789143.lua#L70), `e1:SetLabel(tp, Duel.GetTurnCount()+1)` passes two parameters to a function that accepts only one, causing `e:GetLabel()` to return `nil` and crashing the Lua VM with `attempt to compare number with nil`.

4. **Target Erasure & Copy Effect Breakdown**: In [c244790302.lua](file:///c:/Manual%20Files/Applications/YugiohCCG.github.io/public/CCG%20Downloads/CCG_Scripts/c244790302.lua#L101), calling `Duel.ClearTargetCard()` before storing the handler caused `Duel.GetFirstTarget()` to return `nil` or an irrelevant sub-target, completely bricking the Quick Effect. Similarly, [c245970073.lua](file:///c:/Manual%20Files/Applications/YugiohCCG.github.io/public/CCG%20Downloads/CCG_Scripts/c245970073.lua#L60) omitted target setup entirely.

5. **Premature Battle Expiry**: In [c224822244.lua](file:///c:/Manual%20Files/Applications/YugiohCCG.github.io/public/CCG%20Downloads/CCG_Scripts/c224822244.lua#L86), checking `tc:IsRelateToBattle()` *after* shuffling Rollo into the Deck fails because the battle immediately terminates when Rollo leaves the field.

## Batch: Ghostrick & Eclipse Observer Custom Archetypes (13 Cards)
> **Auditor**: YGO Omega Script & OCGCore Engine Auditor
> **Status**: Completed (Read-Only Audit on Production; Replacement Scripts Validated with luaparse)

An exhaustive audit of 13 custom cards belonging to the **Ghostrick** and **Eclipse Observer** archetypes was conducted against the official YGO Omega ocgcore simulation engine standards, official database rulings, and official Lua scripts in `tmp/omega_scripts/`.
### Summary of Identified Issues Across Batch:

- In `Ghostrick Oni` (`239335848`), the Quick Xyz Summon effect was entirely broken in the original script: it attempted to attach itself to an on-field monster as an overlay unit rather than Xyz Summoning an Extra Deck monster, completely lacking `MustMaterialCheck`, Extra Deck location checks (`GetLocationCountFromEx`), and `Duel.SpecialSummon(sc, SUMMON_TYPE_XYZ...)`.

- In `Ghostrick Cutifer` (`228472690`), control-changing of Set cards used `original_type` instead of checking the card's current zone location (`LOCATION_MZONE` vs `LOCATION_SZONE`), causing invalid field placement of Trap Monsters/Artifacts, and moved on-field cards via `Duel.MoveToField` with `POS_FACEDOWN` instead of `Duel.GetControl(tc, tp)` or proper Spell/Trap positioning.

- In `Ghostrick Pastrygeist` (`259851064`), the Deck-Set effect check (`s.settg`) passed `chk==0` if the player had open Spell/Trap zones but 0 open Monster zones, even if all Set candidates were monsters, leading to illegal activation and resolution failure.
2. **Missing or Inaccurate Categories, Target Flags & Engine Filters**:

- Multiple cards (`Ghostrick Camella`, `Eclipse Observer Maya`, `Eclipse Observer Ella`, `Eclipse Observer Riley`) lacked `CATEGORY_LEAVE_GRAVE` on effects that Special Summon or attach cards from the Graveyard.

- In `Ghostrick Haunt` (`241540236`), position-change targets lacked Link monster exclusion (`c:IsCanChangePosition()`), and position assignment forced cards face-down defense instead of allowing face-up defense choice.
- In `Manual of Eclipse` (`259273851`), banished cards returning to the GY were erroneously filtered through `aux.NecroValleyFilter`.

- In `Ghostrick Slime` (`257677549`), Effect 2 used a soft turn limit (`SetCountLimit(1)`) on a self-flipping effect, which gets cleared by the engine when the card is flipped face-down. It was remediated to standard Ghostrick flag tracking (`RESET_EVENT+RESETS_STANDARD-RESET_TURN_SET+RESET_PHASE+PHASE_END`).

- In `Eclipse Observatory` (`259721372`), the quick negation-and-banish effect checked `tc:IsAbleToRemove()` *before* disabling the card, aborting if the target possessed continuous banish immunity. Negation must occur first, followed by conditional removal.
All 13 replacement Lua scripts provided below are drop-in compatible, syntactically verified via `luaparse`, and adhere strictly to official Konami/Omega engine coding patterns.
